instruction: Increase VLC media player's maximum volume to 200%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VLC's maximum volume setting to 200%. This is done through VLC preferences: Tools > Preferences > All (Show settings: All) > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt > Maximum volume displayed (set to 200). The evaluator reads VLC's configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and checks if 'qt-max-volume=200' is set (default is 125).
metadata.similar_to_original: Both tasks involve VLC configuration. Original task captures video frame for wallpaper (context menu), this task configures maximum volume in advanced preferences (preferences navigation with more steps). Similar domain, slightly more complex navigation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file from platform-specific paths (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric correctly parses config file and extracts 'qt-max-volume' setting, using proper default value of 125
Metric correctly handles 'expected' parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected['max_volume'] (no incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules'))
Expected value of 200 matches instruction requirement to set maximum volume to 200 percent
Full coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
No postconfig needed: VLC config file is persistent and doesn't require specific UI state
Proper error handling for file operations and edge cases
